name: KYB Corporation
summary: KYB Corporation manufactures and sells automotive, hydraulic, and aircraft components worldwide. The company operates through Automotive Components Business, Hydrochemical Components Business, Aerospace Equipment Business, and Special-Purpose Vehicles Business segments. It offers shock absorbers, suspension systems, vane pumps, power supplies, tearing springs, front forks, oil cushion units, stay dampers, free locks, oil dampers for railway vehicles, wire springs, and thin sheet metal parts.
